The '''Nijune system''' was located in the [[Nijune sector/Legends|Nijune sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of the [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was the origin point of the [[Nijune Treasure Fleet]].<ref name="SilentFury" /><ref name="Planetnamia" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Nijune [[Star system/Legends|system]] was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square N-5.<ref name="TEA" />
